title: Where small teams lose time on AI tooling
hook: Three tools, one job, nobody owns the decision.
body:
Small teams add an AI tool for each new problem, and Notion, Slack and Linear each grow a subscription.

Nobody retires the previous one, so 3 tools cover 1 job by March 2026.

The cost shows up at renewal, not at purchase, and the invoice reads $99 per seat.
